description: Generate an article from an APPROVED content-plan entry through research, outline, draft, fact-check, polish, and scoring phases. Returns the article in GENERATING state while processing continues asynchronously. When the article allowance is used up it returns a structured article_allowance_exhausted error.

plan_id.description: Content plan entry id (must be APPROVED)

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.
